backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that manages investment leads with CRUD operations, storing leads in a Set with fields like fundCategory and investmentRange, and providing query functions for filtering, statistics, and counts.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three UI update features (phone number, assets under management, managing clients stats) to their affected frontend component files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose of each component, page, hook, and config file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering colors for backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title to 'JM Financial - Mutual Fund Advisor' and mounting the app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with a shared layout (Navigation, Footer, Toaster) and two routes: HomePage at '/' and DashboardPage at '/dashboard'.
frontend/src/components/AdvisorProfile.t: Advisor profile section displaying Darshit Sheth's credentials, specializations, and floating stat cards showing '150+ Managing Clients' and '14+ Years Experience'.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with JM Financial branding, contact details including the updated phone number +91 97255 01285, quick navigation links, fund category list, and a legal disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/FundCategoriesSe: Renders a grid of mutual fund category cards (Technology, Healthcare, Infrastructure, Real Estate, Renewable Energy) with icons, risk levels, return ranges, and an invest CTA button.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the landing page hero section with a background image, advisor credentials for Darshit Sheth, key stats, and CTA buttons to book a consultation or scroll down.
frontend/src/components/LeadForm.tsx: A consultation request form that collects user details (name, email, phone, city, fund category, investment range, message) and submits them via the useSubmitLead mutation with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile nav links (Home, Advisor Dashboard), and a 'Book Free Consultation' button that smoothly scrolls to the lead form.
frontend/src/components/WhyInvestSection: Displays a grid of benefit cards explaining why Indian investors should choose mutual funds, covering SIP, ELSS tax saving, SEBI regulation, diversification, returns, ESG, and liquidity.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated actor (with Internet Identity) or an anonymous one, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching leads, lead count, and fund category statistics from the backend actor, plus a mutation hook for submitting new leads.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and Tailwind CSS, defining CSS custom properties for a forest-green/gold design system with light and dark mode themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying a searchable table of investor leads along with summary stat cards for total leads, top fund category, and category statistics fetched via React Query.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that composes the Hero, WhyInvest, FundCategories, AdvisorProfile, and LeadForm sections, with smooth-scroll navigation to the lead capture form.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom forest-green and gold color palettes, display/sans font families, and CSS variable-based semantic color tokens.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing the app's purpose (JM Financial mutual fund advisor platform for Darshit Sheth), architectural notes, and a list of implemented features.
